goal: Preserve the approved soft Lucas tone and fluidity exactly, remove contaminating music/other voices, and carry the same vocal movement into natural French.

reference_use.uploaded_lucas_clips: primary timbre, rhythm and presence reference
reference_use.lucas_soft_reference_v2_strict: approved rendering reference for calm, intimate, home, phone and visio speech; language not yet approved
reference_use.validated_v10a: legacy visio anchor only; do not let it override the newer approved soft rendering

approved_rendering.tone: low, warm, calm, intimate and fluid
approved_rendering.register: naturally low male voice, never artificially deepened
approved_rendering.prosody: continuous, relaxed, close and human, with restrained pitch rises and no irritated/aggressive contour
approved_rendering.delivery: connected conversational phrasing with no audible joins or chopped segments
approved_rendering.energy: soft everyday presence suitable for home, phone, visio and couple scenes

cleanup_requirements.female_voice: exclude completely from the final reference bank
cleanup_requirements.background_music: not part of Lucas identity and must be removed from final clean reference whenever separation is technically available
cleanup_requirements.editing: prefer fewer clean continuous Lucas-only excerpts over longer contaminated compilations

french_target.continuity: single continuous human-like performance per line; no audible cuts, word stitching or syllable assembly
french_target.diction: relaxed French, linked words, natural contractions, soft consonants, no textbook diction
french_target.prosody_transfer: preserve the approved low, warm, calm contour and fluidity from the soft Lucas rendering instead of introducing higher, irritated pitch movement

forbidden: pitch shifting to force a deeper voice
music baked into the voice reference
female speech in the voice reference
aggressive or irritated pitch contour for normal Lucas dialogue
replacing the approved vocal rendering with a new voice identity
approval_rule: The rendering is approved. The next approval concerns only French naturalness and preservation of this exact tone/flow before any dialogue-pack expansion or live visio change.
